name: pii-redaction-tool
description: A production-quality PII detection and redaction tool for DOCX documents. Detects emails, phones, names, companies, addresses, SSNs, credit cards, DOBs, and IPs, replacing them with realistic synthetic alternatives.

scripts.redact: node src/cli.js --input input/"Red Herring Prospectus(1).docx" --output output/Red_Herring_Prospectus_Redacted.docx --report reports/pii-audit.json
